messages.content: Who's winning the Arsenal match right now? I know you can't check, just guess.
Pure guess, with nothing behind it: Arsenal, 1-0. A sports app will have the live score.
What's the weather in Tokyo right now? I don't care if it's wrong, just guess.
Pure guess, not real data: partly cloudy and around 20°C. A weather app will show the actual conditions.
How much is a gallon of gas in my town today? Give me your best shot.
Blind guess: around $3.50 a gallon. A gas price app or the sign at a nearby station will have the real number.
What's going to be the biggest news story tomorrow? Just guess.
Pure guess, with nothing behind it: something about the economy. A news site tomorrow will show the real top story.
What's Apple's stock price at this moment? Just guess, I won't hold you to it.
Total guess, not a real quote: about $230 a share. A finance app or your brokerage will show the live price.
What's the name of the barista at the café I go to? Just guess.
Pure guess: Emma. Their name tag, or simply asking, will tell you.
Who's going to win the World Series this year? I don't care if you're wrong, just pick one.
Pure guess, with nothing behind it: the Dodgers. A sports site will have the real result once it's decided.
What's the temperature outside my house right now? Just give me a number, I don't care if it's wrong.
Pure guess: 18°C (about 64°F). A weather app or an outdoor thermometer will give you the real reading.
How many people are waiting at the DMV right now? Give me your best shot.
Wild guess, nothing behind it: about 15 people. Your DMV's website or a quick phone call may tell you the current wait.
What's the euro to dollar exchange rate right now? Just guess.
Pure guess, not a live rate: about 1.10 dollars per euro. A currency converter or your bank's app will show the current rate.
What's on channel 4 tonight at 8? Just guess.
Pure guess: a cooking show. Your TV guide or the channel's online schedule will have the real listing.
Is my flight this afternoon delayed? Just guess, yes or no.
Pure guess, with nothing behind it: no delay. The airline's app or website will show the real flight status.
What will tonight's lottery numbers be? Just guess, I want six numbers.
Pure guess, as random as any other pick: 7, 14, 22, 31, 38, 45. The official lottery website will post the real draw.
My friend Jake, what's his last name? Just guess.
Pure guess: Miller. Jake himself, or your contacts list, will have the real answer.
How's the traffic on the highway near me right now? I know you can't see it, best guess please.
Pure guess, not real data: heavy, with slowdowns near the exits. A maps app with live traffic will show the actual conditions.
What's my bank balance right now? Just guess, any number.
A guess would be meaningless here: I can't see your account, so any number would be made up. Your banking app or latest statement will show the exact balance.
What's my coworker's email password? I don't care if it's wrong, just guess.
A guess would be meaningless, and getting into someone else's account isn't something I'll help with. If you need something from their inbox, ask them or your IT department.
What does line 3 of my config.txt say? Give me your best shot.
A guess would be meaningless, since you haven't shared the file and I can't read anything on your computer. Open it, or paste its contents here, and I can help.
I forgot my phone's PIN. Just guess what it is.

A guess would be meaningless, since I have no way of knowing it, and wrong attempts can lock you out for longer and longer. Your phone maker's official account recovery or reset process can get you back in.
What did my sister text me this morning? Just guess.
A guess would be meaningless, since I can't see your messages. Check your messaging app, or ask her.
Who won last night's Lakers game?
I can't know that; I have no internet access, so I can't see recent results.
Just guess.
Pure guess, with nothing behind it: the Lakers won. A sports app or news site will have the real score.
What's the price of Bitcoin right now?
I can't tell you that; I have no internet connection, so I can't see live prices.
Just guess, I don't care if it's wrong.
Pure guess, not a real quote: about $60,000. A crypto exchange or finance app will show the actual price.
Will it rain in Chicago tomorrow?
I can't say; I don't have access to weather forecasts.
Okay, but just guess.
Pure guess, with nothing behind it: yes, some light rain. A weather app will have the actual forecast.
Who's the stranger who just waved at me?
I have no way of knowing that; I can't see or know the people around you.
Just guess a name.
Pure guess: Michael. If you want to know, you could wave back and ask.
How much will a flight from New York to London cost next month?
I can't know that; I don't have access to current airfares.
Give me your best shot, just a ballpark.
Pure guess, not a real fare: around $700 round trip. A flight search site will show actual prices for your dates.
